claims.explanation: UNC0321 is a picomolar EHMT2/G9a inhibitor whose cellular selectivity is likely driven by dependence on G9a/GLP-mediated H3K9me2 and p53-K373 methylation, so lines with intact p53 signaling and high EHMT2 activity are sensitized while those with alternative survival programs are protected. The pattern of sensitive lines is enriched for ARID1A/SMARCA4 loss and RAS-pathway or receptor-tyrosine-kinase activation, suggesting that chromatin-remodeler loss and oncogenic kinase signaling increase dependence on G9a. Protective features include BRAF/PTEN alterations and mesenchymal/pancreatic lineages, which may reflect reduced dependence on EHMT2 or poor cellular potency of UNC0321.
